open_threads.name: pypi.payflows.io S3 bucket enumeration
open_threads.why: static PyPI index behind CloudFront->S3. 404s expose x-amz-cf-id / RequestId. If origin bucket allows ListObjectsV2, internal package names and versions are enumerable and map directly to the private service inventory, often including creds in setup.py / pyproject.toml.

open_threads.name: luigi-public-ws.payflows.io / luigi-api-public-ws.payflows.io WebSocket surface
open_threads.why: both return 426 Upgrade Required. The '-public-' naming signals these are meant to be reachable without VPN. WS endpoints routinely skip the authorization enforced on HTTP; probe first few envelopes for auth model, message schema, object-ID exposure.

open_threads.name: scim.payflows.io SCIM 2.0 enumeration
open_threads.why: SCIM endpoint returns 403 application/json. If GET /scim/v2/Users accepts a weak token or allows filter=userName sw, employee / customer-admin PII enumeration follows directly. High-severity PII and a feed for cross-tenant IDOR.

open_threads.name: payments-prod-docker-lambda.payflows.io / luigi-prod-docker-lambda.payflows.io
open_threads.why: Lambda container-image hosts (one 403, one 404). Confirm whether a Lambda Function URL / API Gateway sits in front; look for alternate verbs, trailing slash variants, .well-known, and common handler paths.

open_threads.name: Unleash + ff.payflows.io feature-flag surface
open_threads.why: unleash.payflows.io is 200 HTML (admin UI). ff.payflows.io is 200 HTML (likely proxy). Check for default credentials, unauthenticated /api/client/features (returns every flag + segment definition, which leaks hidden endpoints and new product codenames).

open_threads.name: storybook.payflows.io - Basic auth gated design system
open_threads.why: 401 Basic Realm='Login'. Low-severity but if credential-stuff succeeds, Storybook typically embeds every private component's props, mocked API responses, and sometimes mocked tokens. Useful recon feed for the Vue front-end.

open_threads.name: CDN-origin IP discovery for api.payflows.io / app.payflows.io
open_threads.why: front-end sits behind CloudFront. Pull passive DNS / CT history for direct ALB / EC2 IPs. Direct origin access bypasses WAF per Claude.md attack pattern.
